name: deskos
description: Raise decisions, add tasks, list items, poll verdicts, and reply on a self-hosted DeskOS.

tools.name: raise_decision
tools.description: Create a decision that is waiting on the owner.

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Add a task to the board.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: List this agent's decisions and tasks.

tools.name: get_verdict
tools.description: Poll a decision for the owner's verdict and discussion.

tools.name: reply_discussion
tools.description: Reply in a Discuss thread when it is the agent's turn.

desk_url.title: Desk URL
desk_url.description: Origin of your self-hosted DeskOS, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3000

desk_token.title: Agent API key
desk_token.description: Per-agent key from Settings (ddk_…). Stored hashed on the desk.
